The group

Two companies, split by who they serve

Maitri Overseas is the mother company. The work is divided deliberately, so each side of the business stays focused on a different kind of customer.

Mother company

Maitri Overseas

Serves OEMs and end customers directly — auto sectors, kitchen equipment, dairy and elevators. Thirteen years supplying stainless steel sheets and coils across the 200, 300 and 400 series of CR products.

Group company

Rajsheelam Exports

Handles importing, exporting and stockholding. Fifteen years of stainless steel trading and international movement, keeping the material available for the processing lines and for trade customers.

Just-in-time delivery to the customer's doorstep — bigger input units broken into small lots, so you buy what your run actually needs.

What we supply

Stainless steel, in the form your line needs

Slit, cut-to-size, polished and blanked to your drawing, in 200, 300 and 400 series — held to tight processing tolerances.

S.S. welded pipes

Made on our own ERW tube mill, 1″ to 4″ in 0.6 – 2.0 mm wall.

Sheets & plates

Cut to length from 400 mm up to 13,000 mm long, to 1550 mm wide.

Coils & slit coils

Full and slit coils, 400 – 1350 mm wide, re-coiled to the weight you run.

Round bars

Bright and black bar for machining, fasteners and shafting.

Circles & blanks

Zig-zag stamped, 50 – 250 mm diameter — minimum scrap, straight into your draw.

Polished & customised

Patta, patti and polished stainless in the finish you specify. Inventory management and warehousing available, so stock sits with us instead of on your floor.
